title: CloudCam AI Internet Identity-only authentication, protected routes, and consistent branding

requirements.summary: Ensure Internet Identity is the only login method and the /login route provides a clear, working Internet Identity sign-in flow.
acceptanceCriteria: When unauthenticated, users can navigate to /login and initiate an Internet Identity login.
The login UI clearly indicates authentication is handled via Internet Identity (no email/password UI is presented).
On successful login, the user is considered authenticated in the app shell (header/navigation updates accordingly).

file_operations.description: Update the /login UI copy to reference “CloudCam AI” and clearly indicate Internet Identity is used; keep only Internet Identity controls (no email/password). Use existing Internet Identity auth via the authorization component’s frontend guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the authenticated app shell state is clearly reflected in the header (sign-in vs sign-out controls) using the existing Internet Identity state. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance for login/logout behaviors (including clearing cached data on logout); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Protect feature routes (Dashboard and Camera at minimum) so unauthenticated users are redirected to /login, and ensure logout immediately removes access to protected routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /dashboard while logged out redirects to /login.
Visiting /camera while logged out redirects to /login.
After logging out, protected routes are no longer accessible until logging back in.

file_operations.description: Review and harden route protection for /dashboard and /camera so unauthenticated users are redirected to /login (keep using router-level guards). Ensure route protection relies on Internet Identity authentication state per the authorization component’s frontend guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

After logout, proactively navigate the user to /login (in addition to clearing Internet Identity + React Query cache) so protected content is not left visible on-screen. Follow the authorization component’s guidance to clear cached application data on logout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Automatically ensure a basic user account record exists for each authenticated principal on first use, without requiring extra profile fields.
acceptanceCriteria: After first successful login, fetching the caller profile results in an existing profile (auto-created if missing).
Creating a profile is safe to call multiple times for the same principal (does not trap or corrupt state).
No new profile fields beyond the existing principal/createdAt/tier are required to complete account setup.

file_operations.description: Align profile loading with the available backend interface and add an idempotent “ensure profile exists” flow: when authenticated, check whether a profile exists for the current principal and, if missing, create it by saving a minimal UserProfile (principal, createdAt, tier) before re-fetching. Use Internet Identity principal and follow the authorization component’s frontend guidance around profile setup and avoiding modal/flash states; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust dashboard usage of profile hooks so the page behaves correctly during the first-login auto-create flow (loading and error states remain clear; no extra profile fields are requested). Use the authorization component’s guidance for authenticated data access patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Replace inconsistent branding text so the UI consistently uses the product name “CloudCam AI” in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Login page text references “CloudCam AI” (not “CloutChem AI”) in the sign-in messaging.
Header/landing/dashboard user-facing text uses “CloudCam AI” consistently.
No new non-English user-facing strings are introduced as part of this change.

file_operations.description: Replace any remaining “CloutChem AI” references with “CloudCam AI” in user-facing login messaging (English only).

Replace user-facing marketing/CTA references from “CloutChem AI” to “CloudCam AI” (English only), including hero and CTA sections. Ensure any existing hero imagery references remain wired correctly; if using generated assets, reference the existing files at frontend/public/assets/generated/cloutchem-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.
Replace the dashboard welcome/header branding text from “CloutChem AI” to “CloudCam AI” (English only).

Update logo alt text and any header-visible branding text to “CloudCam AI” (English only). Ensure the existing generated logo asset remains correctly referenced at frontend/public/assets/generated/cloutchem-logo.dim_512x192.png.
Replace footer copyright/identifier text from “CloutChem AI” to “CloudCam AI” (English only), including any default identifiers that appear in user-facing contexts.
